description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, managing UI flow based on device profile ownership status.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages the app's main UI and setup flow based on device profile ownership.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and determines whether to show setup or main profile fragment based on device profile ownership status.

methods.name: showSetupProfile
methods.description: Displays the setup profile fragment to the user.

methods.name: showMainFragment
methods.description: Displays the main fragment for the managed profile.
